arabic text: Shimar Ne Mara Jo Dura Tou Sakina Roi
english translation text: When Shimr struck with the whip, Sakina wept.

arabic text: Na Mila Pani Osse Aag Bhujane Ke Liye.\nJal Giya Bhai Ka Jhola Tou Sakina Roi.
english translation text: She found no water with which to extinguish the fire.\nWhen her brother's cradle burned, Sakina wept.

arabic text: Orh Kar Sar Pe Rida Kan Mein Dur Pehne Howay.\nSamne Ayi Jo Ramla Tou Sakina Roi.
english translation text: Wearing a veil upon her head and earrings in her ears,\nwhen Ramla appeared before her, Sakina wept.

arabic text: Mar Kar Syed-e-Mazloom Ke Honton Pe Chari.\nJab Hansa Hakim-e-Kofa Tou Sakina Roi.
english translation text: After killing the oppressed Sayyid, the ruler of Kufa\nclimbed upon his lips and laughed—then Sakina wept.

arabic text: Kya Sakina(SA) Ho Tumhi Itna Bata Do Bibi.\nHind Ne Aa Ke Jo Pocha Tou Sakina Roi.
english translation text: Are you Sakina? Tell me only this, Lady.\nWhen Hind came and asked, Sakina wept.

arabic text: Chahti Thi Ke Woh Le Aaye Osse Khaime Mein.\nBap Ka Lasha Na Utha Tou Sakina Roi.
english translation text: She wished to bring him back to the tents;\nwhen her father's body could not be lifted, Sakina wept.

arabic text: Qaid Mein Sunte Howay Baap Ke Sar Se Lori.\nZakhmi Honton Ko Jo Dekha Tou Sakina Roi.
english translation text: In prison, while hearing a lullaby from her father's head,\nwhen she saw his wounded lips, Sakina wept.

arabic text: MIR SAJJAD: Woh Naqay Se Giri Roi Nahi.\nAa Ke Dadi Ne Uthaya Tou Sakina Roi.
english translation text: O Mir Sajjad, she fell from the camel but did not cry;\nwhen Grandmother came and lifted her, Sakina wept.
